readings.Aries: The relationship that costs you the most energy might be telling you something about your own threshold. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Taurus: Something you made with your hands or your time is more significant than you're giving it credit for. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: You narrate your life in real time. Today, stop narrating and just live the scene. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Cancer: You carry the emotional history of everyone you love. Set some of it down today. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: Your generosity is most powerful when it's not being watched. Give something privately. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: There is a relationship you've been analysing instead of experiencing. Enter it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Libra: The compromise you made is not sitting well. This is information. The first instinct was right.
readings.Scorpio: The investigation you're conducting on someone else — conduct it on yourself for a day. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Sagittarius: The philosophical framework you apply to your own life — apply it with the same generosity to someone else's today. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Capricorn: Something you built is worth protecting. Make sure you're protecting the right parts of it. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: There is someone who would surprise you if you let them. You haven't let them. Let them. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Pisces: You've been in someone else's current for a while. Find your own direction. Something is about to become obvious.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
